stage_metadata.query: SELECT Id, MasterLabel, IsActive, SortOrder, IsClosed, IsWon, DefaultProbability, ForecastCategoryName FROM OpportunityStage ORDER BY SortOrder
stage_metadata.note: Plus a describe of Opportunity.StageName for the per-record-type picklist subsets.

opportunities.query: SELECT Id, Name, StageName, Amount, CreatedDate, CloseDate, LastModifiedDate, IsClosed, IsWon, Type, LeadSource, Loss_Reason__c, OwnerId, Owner.Name, RecordType.Name FROM Opportunity WHERE CreatedDate = LAST_N_DAYS:540 ORDER BY CreatedDate LIMIT 5000
opportunities.note: Amount floor applied in the analyser, not the query, so the excluded count is reportable.

stage_history.query: SELECT OpportunityId, StageName, Amount, ExpectedRevenue, CloseDate, CreatedDate, SystemModstamp FROM OpportunityHistory WHERE CreatedDate = LAST_N_DAYS:540 ORDER BY OpportunityId, CreatedDate LIMIT 50000
stage_history.note: OpportunityHistory also writes a row on Amount/CloseDate edits; duplicate consecutive stages are collapsed by the analyser.

lead_lifecycle.query: SELECT Id, Status, CreatedDate, IsConverted, ConvertedOpportunityId, LeadSource FROM Lead WHERE CreatedDate = LAST_N_DAYS:540 LIMIT 5000
